coverage_gap._note: uncovered_coastal = reference coastal countries with ZERO GEM LNG terminals → discovery worklist (Discovery SOP §4.0: iterate covered ∪ uncovered). gem_countries_outside_reference = GEM-covered countries absent from country_universe.py → add them there (or fix a name) so they don't read as a false gap.

dormant_revival_watch._note: Wholly cancelled/shelved in-scope terminals = dead SITES to revival-check during Discovery (Discovery SOP §4.0a / §6). A genuinely different new project at one of these sites is a NEW terminal per the dead-and-revived rule (lifecycle_rules.md), not an edit to the dead record. 'high' priority = dead 5+ years (Discovery SOP §12). This is the blind spot that let POIC Lahad Datu slip past a sweep.
